en: Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish
zh: 为 `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator` 新增 `--shutdown-drain-sec`：收到 SIGTERM 时停止轮询，并给进行中的轮询和正在运行的 spawn hook 最多这么多秒完成
